Background:
You probably remember that at launch Stellaris included an army "Attachment" system. This let you modify armies, upgrading them in fun ways like mounting them as cavalry or deploying swarms of killer drones. With 2.2 the army attachments were removed due to player complaints about excessive clicking. Rather than improving the UI, Paradox junked the lot and unfortunately threw a bunch of great colour, story and lore content in the bin.

What you likely don't remember is that during a dev stream at the time, the game director, Wiz, speculated he would bring attachments back. That never happened. Wiz is gone and the modern devs have talked about being uninterested in ground combat.

What you almost definitely have no idea about is that there are many unused yet incredibly cool and professionally written attachment ideas by Paradox in the game files.

Overview:
This mod adds six technologies to your game that bring back army attachments! Attachments do two things: They confer an empire wide bonus to all your troops and also spawn armies when combat begins.

There are roughly 70 attachments to discover, inside you'll find:

[*]Original Release attachments, like Xenomorph Cavalry, Power Armour, Neo-Concrete Fortifications
 [*]Unreleased PDX attachments, such as Raptor Flocks, Exploding Slave Collars, Battle Worms, Class-A Psionics, Shadow Assassins
[*]New attachments, to fill balance holes in the mod, hopefully still cool like Mechs, Active Camouflage, Xeno-morph Queens and more.


There are more than ten paths to play through, with attachments for all kinds of empires, armies and ascension paths.

https://imgur.com/jv6wjvg.gif
Attachment Types:
https://imgur.com/DQQbo3D.png
Attachments are broken into five specialisations. You decide the order you unlock them and can prioritise the ones most suited to your empire.

[*]Equipment, like Flame-Throwers, Jet-Packs and Cybernetic Replacements
[*]Infrastructure, like Air-Defence artillery, Neo Concrete, Tremor or Storm Generators
[*]Reinforcements, like the Military police corp, Cybernetic Infiltrators, Genetic Shock Troopers, or Suicide Clone Brigade
[*]Beasts, like Mutant Hordes, Xenomorph Brood Coordinators, War Canines or Battle Worms
[*]Vehicles, like Hover-Tanks, Battle Striders, War Speeders, Dropships or Mechs


🎮How To Play:
Unlike Vanilla, in which equipping attachments required hundreds of tedious clicks, you now apply attachments to all armies at once. 

[*] First, research any of the six technologies. (They're all in Military theory.)
[*] Second, select your attachment specialisation on the pop-up.
[*] Third, and finally, head to the Attachment Library (found in edicts) to equip whatever you want!
[*] That's it!


💪Attachment Rarities/Strengths:
Attachments come in varying strengths. As you progress through the tiers you'll be able to equip more and more of them, up to a maximum of six at once. The rarities are:

[*]Basic (T1)
[*]Complex (T2)
[*]Advanced (T3)
[*]Exotic (T4)
[*]Master (T5)
[*]Grandmaster (T6)


🪖Attachment Armies:
In addition to an empire bonus, each attachment spawns a unique army to fight for you. For example, if you use the Military Police attachment, you'll gain units of Military Police Corps in your ground invasions.

These new armies are completely micro-free. They have no cost, they do not have to be manually recruited or taken in transport ships: They automatically spawn when combat begins, and leave when combat ends.

There is a unique army for every single attachment, and I really enjoyed dreaming them up. They can be anything from Flame-Thrower Brigades, to Clone Decoys, to Android Snipers to Xenomorph Queens.

https://imgur.com/pb2u7wT.gif

For full documentation I have [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1o8JBOccyYcezIExJKO4JMrdUOvyb3yTmWIvRp-5E_iw/edit?usp=sharing]a google sheet here.

➕My Recommendations:

[*]My "Planet View" mod improves the army screen and has special interaction with this mod, displaying attachments in a fancy way.
[*]My mod Dangerous Wildlife Expanded gives you bonus attachment content (the cavalry feature.)
[*]For more recommendations and compatibility advice check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3419342219]my collection at the top of this page.

As of Stellaris 4.0, trade route no longer contribute to lag and this mod will no longer receive update. Thanks for all your support during this journey. This mod will remain published in workshop for compatibility reason to older versions of stellaris. 

Motivation:
Trade routes has appear to become a primary contributor to mid to late game lag. The path finding and trade protection calculation is suspected to be the main culprit behind the decrease in game speed. 

Original Reddit post: https://www.reddit.com/r/Stellaris/comments/1b3cjrg/in_my_experience_these_are_the_biggest/

While there are other mods that deals with this issue, most either appear to be abandoned or deprecated, or too complicated and causes compatibility issues with other mods. 

This mod aims to keep vanilla trade behavior, while at the same time keep compatibility with most other mods. 

Design:
This mod applies a country effect to all countries at the start of the game that set starbase collection radius and protection range to 0. 
The starbase in capital system gains a modifier that increase trade collection range to max. This eliminate the need of calculating trade route and trade protection.

Additional Changes:
The following has been changed due to becoming useless with trade route removable.

Trade hub: Increase trade value by 4
Hyperlane Registrar: Increase trade value by 6
Mercantile adoption effect: Increase trade value by 5%

Thanks to -F.T.L.- Solomun for the suggestion

If this mod is having compatibility issue with one of your overhaul mod, you can try the compatibility version here without those changes:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3403656496

Load order does not matter for compatibility version as no vanilla file is modified. 

Known issue:
Trade pirate should no longer spawn with this mod enabled, since trade routes no longer exist. 

Bug Report and Suggestions:
This mod is still in early development, so please report any bug you see to the comments or discussions. 
If you have any suggestions to make the mod better, please let me know.

Mod compatibility:
Overwrites:
common/starbase_modules/trade_hub section.
common/starbase_buildings/warp_fluctuator section.
common/traditions/tr_mercantile_adopt section.

Should be compatible with most mods that modifies trade value.

FAQ:
Can this mod be added to old save?
This mod can be added without any further action required for singe player saved game. 

For multiplayer saved game, there is an additional edict "Enable MP Trade modifier" that need to be activated. If you don't see the edict, it means either this mod has already been activated or there was an installation issue. Check your capital starbase trade collection range to confirm mod activation. (Thanks to 𝅳𝅳𝅳𝅳𝅳𝅳𝅳𝅳  for the suggestion)

translations.description_clean:
This mod adds several portraits based on the Transformers depicted in the War for Cybertron games.

Features
1. Several cybertronian portraits: Autobot, Decepticon, Neutral, Maximal, Predacon, Vehicon, and Insecticon
2. Two shipsets for both factions (now NSC compatible)
3. Four custom citysets: Autobot, Decepticon, Neutral, and Insecticon
4. Several Cybertronian Origins:

- Fall of Cybertron: Start on a war-torn Cybertron that will begin a core shutdown event similar to the Doomsday 
 origin where you'll have to evacuate Cybertron before it goes completely offline.

- War for Cybertron: Start on Cybertron just before the Great War. This origin will include story events that will eventually lead to a massive Decepticon uprising for control of Cybertron which will determine the fate of your entire empire.

- Cybertronian Colony Origins: Start on a cybertronian colony in a random solar system either an Energon or Dark Energon starting point. This origin will also spawn an abandoned Cybertron somewhere in the galaxy. 

- Pax Cybertronia: Start on Cybertron during the Golden Age. Strong start which includes the AllSpark relic that increases robot assembly speed and energy/energon production. 

- Insecticon Hive: Start on a random Cybertronian colony infested with Insecticons (For gestalt empires only). 

5. New strategic resources: Energon and Dark Energon - unlocks new edicts and armies. 
6. New buildings: Energy Refineries/Mines - adds two energon refiner and miner jobs respectively that produce energon, energon crystals, energy, and amenities.
7. Autobot/Maximal, Decepticon/Predacon, Vehicon, and Functionist civics: Also unlocks several unique armies based on these factions (i.e. Insecticons, Dinobots, Combiners, Omega Supreme, & Trypticon). 
8. Several government types based on the civics mentioned above including new opinion modifiers when interacting with other empires. 
9. Multiple new species traits: Cybertronian (ascension perk subclasses included), Faction traits: Autobot/Maximal, Decepticon/Predacon, Vehicon, etc. 
10. Cybertron themed rooms 
11. Cybertronian faction namelists
12. Cybertronian relics
13. Cybertronian utility components
14. Cybertronian/Dark Energon ship weapon components

Introduction
This mod enables you to fill the galaxy with more life by creating new primitive civilizations or breeding your own space creatures. I constantly work on and update the mod. Below you'll find a list of planned future features.

If you have any feedback regarding balance or want to tell me about bugs and compatibility issues please use the section "Compatibility & Bugs" which you find above the comment section.

https://i.imgur.com/ELbeWmE.png
Feature Overview
This is a list of all features. For more details scroll down.

[*] Build Seed Ships to create new primitive civilizations
[*] A new observation mission to advance primitives to their next stage
[*] Origin 'The Creators' that unlocks seed ships from the start of the game as well as other features
[*] Breed spacecreatures:

[*] A new megastructure where space creaturers and leviathans are breed
[*] Two new ascension perks to unlock more leviathans



https://i.imgur.com/Ze3XcVE.png
Seed Ships
Seed Ships work like any other colony ship but will destroy the colony immediately and generate a random primitive civilization somewhere between the stone age and steam age.

In order to unlock Seed Ships the technology 'Sapient Life Engineering' (T5) must be researched. It has several prerequisites too (Targeted Gene Expressions, Gene Seed Purification and Gene Banks) so it will usually only come up very late into the game. 

Primitives created this way will be completely randomized (portrait, name, traits etc.)

Additionally I've added a new observation mission to bring primitives to the next age instead of making them a space faring empire right away by enlighting them.

https://i.imgur.com/G3jwXV3.png
Origin 'The Creators'
The origin works similar to the scion origin but you won't be the vassal of some fallen empire. Instead the ancient caretakers will look up to you and offer you tribute as well as other benefits over time. Here is a list of all features:

[*] Unlocks Sapient Life Engineering (Seed Ships) from the game start
[*] Colony and seed ships cost 50% less 
[*] Start on a size 25 Relic world with special blockers
[*] The Ancient Caretakers will recognize you and:

[*] Give you a relic upon first contact that allows you to summon a single FE battlecruiser every 10 years
[*] Have some special dialogue
[*] Will not give you tasks but instead pay you tribute in the form of ressources, technology or fleets sometimes



https://i.imgur.com/fzUqZWc.png
Breed Space Creatures
The long awaited update has finally arrived. You can now breed your own army of space creatures. Below is a detailed explanation of all the features this update will bring. Additionally the Bio Engineering Facility screen will explain a lot about the different space creatures and their stats. Most of them have been buffed a little bit so they stay competitive with normal space ships over the course of the game.

https://i.imgur.com/cm2j12U.png
The Bio Engineering Facility
The new megastructure is the place where you can select which creatures to breed. It is unlocked by the technology 'Bio Engineereng Program', a T3 technology with the prerequisites Cloning, Genome Mapping and Xenobiology.

It has 2 Stages, an initial stage to build the construction platform and the final stage. 
The first stage costs 1000 alloys and 100 influence. The final stage costs 2500 alloys and 1500 food.  It has a monthly upkeep of 15 energy and 25 food and produces 150 society research as well as add 30 naval capacity.

The Bio Engineering Facility can only be build around single stars and blackholes, not in binary or trinary systems.

To access the breeding overview select the megastructure and click on the button 'breed creatures'.
 
https://i.imgur.com/QOWlB86.png
Ascension Perks
Leviathan Engineering
Leviathan Engineering unlocks most of the Leviathans:

[*] Tiyanki Matriarch
[*] Crystal Core
[*] Shroud Avatar
[*] Voidspawn
[*] Ether Drakes
[*] Dimensional Horror

To select Leviathan Engineering you have to have unlocked at least 2 other ascension perks.
Ultimate Leviathan Engineering
Ultimate Leviathan Engineering unlocks the Stellar Devourer. The most powerful of all the Leviathans.

To select Ultimate Leviathan Engineering you have to have unlocked at least 3 other ascension perks AND the ascension perk Leviathan Engineering.

https://i.imgur.com/KqIEGQN.png
Space Amoebas
The space amoeba section includes:

[*] Amoeba Hatchlings
[*] Amoeba Mothers
[*] Amoeba Centenarians

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=738842496]Pre-FTL players has been updated for 2.0. This mod will be archived. Maybe I'll resuscitate it for 1.9 as a side effect of making a Primitive Players 1.9 variant.

1.8 compatible! 

Start Stellaris in the early days of space travel, when FTL is merely theoretical & a practical drive system has yet to be concieved. All empires except fallen start with no FTL, only 1 of 3 theories. Practical drives must be researched & retrofitted before ships can leave their starting systems. Theory and first drive techs are rare. Exploiting your home system is much more important than in vanilla. 

In the meantime, conventional and now ion based thrusters allow ships to set out on multi-year voyages (similar to warp drive but only ~10% as fast) prior to discovery of FTL. Advanced start AIs already did so many years ago & their colonies are well established.

Features

[*]No FTL at start, you must research physics labs to get your first practical drive.
[*]All FTL types are available for research. Researching multiple theories will help you get a drive faster, but your first may not be your starting choice.
[*]2 STL drives, starting chemical thrusters for 0.5c for science and colony ships, and later fusion powered ion thrusters that move all ships at just under c.
[*]Colony ship maintenance reduced to 1 energy per month.
[*]FTL Mapmode: Based on Birdy's work, shows the highest FTL technology researched in each empire. Psi > Jump > Wormhole 3 > Hyper 3 > Warp 3> Wormhole 2 > ... all the way down to none. They may have lesser drives also. 


STL drive

[*]Most travel time is spent in windup/winddown rather than moving, due to a Stellaris bug where ships will not leave the galaxy view on arrival at their destination if they're moving too slowly. 
[*]Set STL ships off of evasive fleet stance, or they'll abandon a year's worth of windup to switch destinations when a hostile arrives. 
[*]STL ships show as idle the entire duration of the warp winddown. Send them into an orbit so you know to come back when they're ACTUALLY idle.
[*]A scientist can & should support multiple STL science ships due to down time traveling (unless you're RPing). 
[*]STL ships in a wormhole empire will show the range ring as if they were a wormhole station. Graphical bug only.


Gameplay impacts / advice
Setup: Probably want more AIs than you usually prefer, since several of them will likely still be pre FTL by the time you get FTL. AI production bonuses will help them less (less turn advantage), so you might want to increase difficulty as well. Thanks to changes in 1.8 that don't work, this mod should but does not support FTL-restricted (i.e. hyperlane only) galaxies, you still need the PreFTL Players variant.

Builds: Science & physics builds will get a head start on average, but science builds aren't great at rushing and everyone gets plenty of time to build an in-system fleet, so that's probably OK. The +1 research alternative government (and tech) is very powerful here.

FTL research: All practical drives are tech tier 2 and unlocked by the physics lab. The theory techs are rare, but will unlock more practical techs and increase your odds with them. More tech alternatives help a lot. Researching a practical drive makes the other 2 even rarer. So if your favorite doesn't come up first, you have an interesting strategic tradeoff to make.

AI: AI will mostly stick to its first FTL type unless a higher tier drive of another type becomes available, which should be very rare. AI is not great about upgrading its ships, which hurts it more than usual here when starting ships have no FTL. I've tried to fix this, it may have helped.

Event Ships (Pirates/Cultists/Shipyards/etc):  Should spawn with the FTL you have. Pirate and cultist events should not trigger until after you get FTL. If you trigger the shipyard or gas giant ship anomalies with STL, you should get jump drive ships. Lots of shoulds, y'all let me know.

Crises: Their calendar trigger dates are unchanged, so you and the AIs will be less ready for them. Unbidden will still be triggered by jump drives, so they'll come later than vanilla.

Please, add your own thoughts / tips / tricks / warnings [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/741282313/305510202682848899/]here. Y'all play my mod a whole lot more than I get to, help each other out.

Variants
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=738842496]Pre-FTL players: Only your starting drive type is researchable. A Pre-FTL start to vanilla. Do not use these two mods together or with Primitive Players.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/discussions/743509790]Future Plans / Hopes
If you want to be part of beta testing, sign up for that mod. Or take an idea from the list & code it

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=741313454]Recommended Mods

A colonization mod or rushing droids for expanded colony options is probably almost necessary to really enjoy pre-FTL gameplay.

timOkill's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1195902331]Tech Tier Events mod will help you keep track of how many more techs you need to unlock practical FTL.

Compatibility Issues
Two base game files have been altered, 00_utilities_drives and 00_physics_tech. This mod will not be compatible with other mods that alter these files. Issues with specific mods are discussed [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/741282313/3055102026828

New (or repurposed FE) war goals include:
- Stopping atrocities (such as purging, pre-FTL exploitation or slavery)
- Protecting the environment by protecting pre-sapients and space fauna (requires Environmentalist civic, or Tree of Life or Life-Seeded origins).
- As a spiritualist empire, stopping the spread of AI by outlawing its use. 
- As a materialist empire, encourage the spread of AI by forcing its legalisation.
- De-militarising a rival by changing its war policies and disbanding its fleets and armies. 
- As a fanatic xenophobe or militarist, cleansing a neighbour's border worlds.
- As a militarist empire, wage total war aganist crime and piracy across the galaxy.
- Spread the workers' revolution across the stars as a egalitarian empire, or crush it in its cradle as a reactionary autocracy.

意见征集：新版和旧版你会觉得哪种更可视化和易用？

BUG及建议/需求反馈群（QQ）：715275556。更新日志见改动说明。
其他版本链接：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3481817220] [3.14旧版]  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3687213977] [4.2版]  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3751400862] [4.3版]  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564948226] [测试版] 

 使用方法 
主要操作在殖民地迁移控制面板、国家迁移控制面板中进行，另有殖民地决议迁入平民人口。

[*] 决议“打开人口迁移控制面板”，打开殖民地迁移控制面板。
[*] 法令“国家迁移控制面板”，打开国家迁移控制面板。
[*] 法令“在突触凝炼机打开人口迁移控制面板”，打开突触凝炼机迁移控制面板。


法令仅作为按钮使用，无需保持激活，激活后第二天自动失效，属于正常现象。
自动迁移默认为每月第二天迁移。可通过国家面板设置为每1~12个月执行，每次执行延迟0~29天。

 人口收容 
支持将殖民地设置为人口收容所，自动或手动迁移全国符合条件的人口到收容所。
 主要功能 

[*] 自动迁移：在迁移目的地的殖民地面板，勾选所需人口的类别，设置为收容所并自动迁移。
[*] 手动迁移：在迁移目的地的殖民地面板，点击所需人口的“执行”按钮，手动迁移一次。
[*] 人口收容所容量（可选）：迁入时不会使得当前殖民地的总人口超过该容量。
[*] 优先级（可选）：处理多个收容所之间的顺序。特别地，优先级较高的收容所能从优先级较低、“迁移对象”相同的收容所迁入人口。优先级范围-5~5，默认为0。
[*] 物种控制（可选）：选择仅收容主物种或外族物种，默认收容所有物种。未被收容的物种可以被其它“迁移对象”相同的收容所收容，不受优先级限制。


迁出殖民地黑 / 白名单、保留部分人口不被迁走等功能，见迁出控制。

 支持范围 


   迁移依据 
   可设置的迁移对象 


   人口阶层 
  平民，维护子个体，生物质， 失业活体陈设，经济舱乘客，在岗（精英专家劳工），在岗子个体 


   无上限岗位 
   仆从，杂勤 


   公民权 
   居留权、同化 


   奴役类型 
   牲口、侍仆、杂勤、并入电网、智慧标本 


   净化类型 
   强制劳役、加工、化学处理、充分利用、突触服役 


表中“无上限岗位”对应殖民地经济页面的岗位，其它对应殖民地管理页面的人口组。

 岗位填充 
自动或手动迁移迁移人口，直到目的地岗位填满。忽略空闲岗位少于100个的殖民地，优先选择宜居度较高的人口。目前会检测原版主要岗位的上岗条件，尽量避免迁移无法上岗的人口。

支持范围：无上限岗位、一般失业阶层、失业活体陈设。

[*] 殖民地迁入：通过殖民地面板，从其它殖民地迁入符合条件的人口；通过决议迁入平民人口快速迁入平民岗位的人口；
[*] 殖民地迁出：通过殖民地面板，迁出符合条件的人口至其它殖民地；
[*] 全国填岗：通过国家面板的迁出按钮，分散人口填充各殖民地的岗位，也可设置定期自动从所有殖民地迁出。


 迁出控制 
此设置对人口收容、岗位填充同时生效。仅对同一“迁移对象”迁移有效（例如禁止迁出平民阶层，不影响迁出到平民岗位收容所）。
在国家面板，设置本 Mod 从所有殖民地迁出人口时，保留的此类人口数量。禁止按钮代表禁止通过本 Mod 迁出此类人口。
在对应殖民地的面板，设置从当前殖民地迁出时保留的数量，覆盖国家面板的设置。

常见用法（以平民为例）：

[*] 保留保底平民：在国家面板，设置默认保留的平民数，如 2000。
[*] 黑名单模式（不从特定星球迁出平民）：在黑名单殖民地，设置禁止迁出平民。
[*] 白名单模式（只从某几个人口球迁出平民）：在国家面板，设置默认禁止迁出平民；在白名单殖民地，设置迁出保留0个平民（或其它想“保留保底平民”的数量）。




 补充说明 
该mod旨在模拟原版的手动强制迁移，所有与原版手动迁移不符之处视为bug。特性包括：

[*] 仅迁移原版规则下允许强制迁移的人口。
[*] 不迁移殖民地的最后一个已开智人口，因为会废弃殖民地。
[*] 在迁移人口的同时根据原版人口阶层、国民理念、费用修正等因素，自动扣除等同于原版手动迁移的费用。
[*] 迁移人口以 100 为单位，除非能迁移整个人口组。
如果一个人口组中只有部分人口符合迁移条件且不足100，便不会迁移。


受蠢驴的无上限岗位数量计算 bug 影响，代码读到的空闲岗位数量可能少于实际岗位数量。本Mod对原版的此类岗位（例如扈从）作了校正，但如果其他 Mod 添加了无上限岗位，即使岗位未生效，也可能影响相关计算。

Mod 中所有涉及岗位计算的功能，均需要刷新殖民地岗位信息，产生相对高的耗时。本 Mod 迁出人口后尽量不主动刷新岗位信息，岗位页面可能显示错误的人口数量。手动拉动任一岗位的上限条，可立即刷新当前所在殖民地的岗位。
